{{Current events|year=2025|month=05|day=7|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2025 India–Pakistan standoff]]
**[[2025 India–Pakistan border skirmishes]]
***[[2025 India–Pakistan strikes]]
****[[India]]n airstrikes impact multiple locations in [[Pakistan]] and [[Azad Kashmir|Pakistan-administered Kashmir]], killing at least 8 people. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/india-launches-attack-9-sites-pakistan-pakistan-occupied-jammu-kashmir-2025-05-06/ (Reuters)] [https://www.indiatoday.in/india/story/operation-sindoor-live-updates-indian-armed-forces-carried-out-precision-strike-at-terrorist-camps-2720648-2025-05-07 (''India Today'')]
****[[Pakistan]] launches retaliatory strikes into India and [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Indian-administered Kashmir]], and claims to have destroyed five [[India]]n fighter jets. Three civilians are killed. [https://tribune.com.pk/story/2544343/indian-missile-strikes-hit-muzaffarabad-kotli-and-bahawalpur-amid-escalating-tensions (''The Express Tribune'')] [https://aje.io/ur4viu?update=3692686 (Al Jazeera)]
****[[Prime Minister of Pakistan|Pakistani prime minister]] [[Shehbaz Sharif]] declares the Indian attacks to be an [[casus belli|act of war]] and vows further retaliation. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/india-fires-missiles-terrorist-infrastructure-pakistan-india/story?id=121535137 (ABC News)]
****A [[State of emergency|state of emergency]] is declared in Pakistan's [[Punjab, Pakistan|Punjab]] province following the airstrikes, with all schools in the region being closed. Hospitals and emergency services are placed on high alert. [https://tribune.com.pk/story/2544374/punjab-declares-emergency-after-indian-attack-closes-schools (''The Express Tribune'')]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[Israeli bombing of the Gaza Strip]]
****According to [[Hamas]] officials, [[Israel]]i airstrikes kill at least 92 [[Palestinians]], including women, children, and two [[Killing of journalists in the Gaza war|journalists]], and wound at least 86 others. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-news-07-05-2025-e6c7f8b3b57f24518e1e66a66fee7713 (AP)]
**[[Palestinian political violence]]
***Four people are injured, at least two seriously, in a [[drive-by shooting]] at a car at the [[Reihan]] crossing in the [[West Bank]]. [https://www.ynetnews.com/article/hys58xkxgg (YNet)] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/4-said-wounded-in-shooting-attack-in-northern-west-bank/ (''Times of Israel'')] [https://www.israelnationalnews.com/news/407989 (''Arutz Sheva'')]
***One person is injured in an attempted car ramming and stabbing in [[Mount Hebron]] in the [[West Bank]]. [https://www.ynetnews.com/article/hys58xkxgg (YNet)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[The Walt Disney Company]] announces plans to open its seventh [[Disneyland Abu Dhabi|theme park]] in [[Abu Dhabi]], [[United Arab Emirates]], their first in the [[Middle East]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cdrgr2zzv00o (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Eleven [[kindergarten]] teachers are killed in a collision between a [[minibus]] and [[dump truck]] in [[Purworejo Regency]], [[Central Java]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-road-crash-teachers-dead-java-truck-f6222178fdaa2f2acdb535edb6a2b954 (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*A woman is [[Decapitation|decapitated]] and a security guard is critically injured in a [[axe]] [[mass stabbing]] attack by a 22-year-old Polish citizen on the campus of [[University of Warsaw]] at an auditorium in [[Warsaw]], [[Poland]]. A day of mourning is declared. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/polish-police-detain-man-after-he-kills-one-person-with-axe-warsaw-university-2025-05-07/ (Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cx2w2898p1jo (BBC News)]
*One student is killed and two others are injured in a [[mass stabbing]] attack outside the entrance of [[Santa Ana High School]] in [[Orange County, California|Orange County]], [[California]], United States. [https://ktla.com/news/local-news/1-killed-2-hospitalized-in-stabbing-attack-outside-santa-ana-high-school/ (KTLA)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 papal conclave]]
**A total of 133 [[Cardinal electors in the 2025 papal conclave|cardinal electors]] begin the process of [[Papal conclave|electing]] a new [[pope]] following [[Death and funeral of Pope Francis|the death]] of [[Pope Francis]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/may/07/cardinals-begin-choosing-new-pope-conclave (''The Guardian'')]
**The conclave's first ballot fails to elect a new pope. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2025/05/07/conclave-voting-begins-new-pope/ (''The Washington Post'')]
